cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Assigned by Procedure
cards.instruction: Get someone to accept an unwanted responsibility by proving that the rules, rotation, or tradition make it theirs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've slid my keys across like you. Presidential handover. Congratulations; those are the toilet keys.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was returning a spare. I thought the caretaker cleaned the toilets.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Spare accounted for. We voted to save that fee; the minutes assign closing and cleaning to the president.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I proposed that when you were president.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, and I cleaned them all year. Your first duty is continuing your savings.

reason: Name toilets in B2 instead of making 'cleaned them' refer past the stated keys. Preserve all actual handover and vote history.
